import html from typing import List # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. Use {username}, {title}, # {body} and {tags} to inject content safely. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {username}

{body}
{tags}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a user's forum post. Args: username_key: The identifier of the post's creator. title_key: The heading of the user's post. body_key: The primary content of the user's post. tag_elements: A sequence of tags associated with the post. Returns: A string containing an XSS‑protected HTML version of the user's forum post. """ # Escape all user supplied data to prevent XSS. safe_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=False) # Build the tags string: each tag is wrapped in a element. safe_tags = [] for tag in tag_elements: # Ensure the tag itself is escaped; do not allow injection of markup. escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(safe_tags) # Insert the escaped components into the template. rendered_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html ) return rendered_html.strip()
